approved: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
The bill would authorise the remaining 7/12ths of the estimated 2025-26 annual government spending from the Consolidated Revenue Fund.
It would provide funding for the final seven months of 2025-26, including for Budget measures, and replaces bills that lapsed when Parliament was dissolved.

The reintroduced bill is substantially the same as the lapsed version but includes changes from the 2025 Pre-election Economic and Fiscal Outlook, election commitments, and new entities like the Defence and Veterans' Services Commission.
Authorises the remaining 7/12ths of estimated 2025-26 annual appropriations.
Provides funding for the 2025-26 Budget measures and selected election commitments.
Includes direct appropriations for two new non-corporate Commonwealth entities.
The government and its agencies, including new entities such as the Defence and Veterans' Services Commission and the Australian Naval Nuclear Power Safety Regulator.

Declared that Appropriation Bill (No. 1) 2025-2026, Appropriation Bill (No. 2) 2025-2026 and Appropriation (Parliamentary Departments) Bill (No. 1) 2025-2026 stood referred to the Federation Chamber for further debate.
Returned Appropriation Bill (No. 1) 2025-2026, Appropriation Bill (No. 2) 2025-2026 and Appropriation (Parliamentary Departments) Bill (No. 1) 2025-2026 to the House for further consideration.

Moved to suspend standing and sessional orders to set expedited proceedings and portfolio timeframes for the appropriation bills, require questions to be put without debate at specified stages, and allow variations only on a motion moved by a Minister.
